scripts.build:backend: cd apps/backend && npm run build && npx @vercel/ncc build dist/main.js -o dist/ncc --minify && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.join('node_modules', '.prisma', 'client', 'query_engine-windows.dll.node'); const dest = path.join('dist', 'ncc', 'query_engine-windows.dll.node'); if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.copyFileSync(src, dest); console.log('[Build] Copied Prisma query engine to dist/ncc'); } else { console.error('[Build Error] Prisma query engine not found at: ' + src); }"
scripts.setup: npm install && cd apps/backend && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npm run db:seed && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../desktop && npm install
scripts.desktop: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "cd apps/desktop && npm start"
scripts.build:desktop: npm run db:reset && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && node copy-frontend.js && node copy-backend.js && cd apps/desktop && npm run build
scripts.tauri:dev:full: npm run build:backend && concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "tauri dev"
scripts.tauri:build: npm run db:reset && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && tauri build
